title: Twin density peaks and alternating spatial lobes
description: Cases 409700 and 2298665 have three positive numerical Lyapunov exponents in three-dimensional maps with deformed torus projections. The two density peaks of Case 409700 occasionally repeat on consecutive steps. In Case 2298665 a plane separates the odd and even states of the displayed sample.
coordinates: Native Cartesian states with a principal-axis camera and equal axis scales. The displayed clouds contain 250,000 consecutive iterations per case.
